'''Luiz Pinguelli Rosa''' (19 February 1942 – 3 March 2022) was a Brazilian scientist.

==Life and career==
A [[nuclear physics|nuclear physicist]], researcher and professor at the [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]], he was also a scientific leader. He was born in [[Third Brazilian Republic|Brazil]] and lived in the city of [[Rio de Janeiro]].

One of Rosa's fields of activity was [[renewable energy]]. 

He was also scientifically and politically active in the field of [[Nuclear power|nuclear energy]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.abc.org.br/~lrosa |title=Academia Brasileira de Ciéncias |access-date=24 December 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090327002613/http://www.abc.org.br/%7ELROSA/ |archive-date=27 March 2009 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.jornaldamidia.com.br/noticias/2010/11/01/Brasil/Pinguelli_Rosa_defende_politica_d.shtml |title=Pinguelli Rosa defende política de petróleo e critica setor elétrico - Jornal da Mídia |website=www.jornaldamidia.com.br |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110706153333/http://www.jornaldamidia.com.br/noticias/2010/11/01/Brasil/Pinguelli_Rosa_defende_politica_d.shtml |archive-date=2011-07-06}} </ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://pqasb.pqarchiver.com/latimes/access/60156252.html?dids=60156252:60156252&FMT=ABS&FMTS=ABS:FT&type=current&date=Oct+06%2C+1990&author=WILLIAM+R.+LONG&pub=Los+Angeles+Times+(pre-1997+Fulltext)&desc=UPDATE+%2F+NUCLEAR+PROLIFERATION+Brazil+May+Not+Have+Ended+Development+of+an+A-Bomb&pqatl=google|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121104191449/http://pqasb.pqarchiver.com/latimes/access/60156252.html?dids=60156252:60156252&FMT=ABS&FMTS=ABS:FT&type=current&date=Oct+06,+1990&author=WILLIAM+R.+LONG&pub=Los+Angeles+Times+(pre-1997+Fulltext)&desc=UPDATE+%2F+NUCLEAR+PROLIFERATION+Brazil+May+Not+Have+Ended+Development+of+an+A-Bomb&pqatl=google|url-status=dead|archive-date=4 November 2012|title=UPDATE / NUCLEAR PROLIFERATION Brazil May Not Have Ended Development of an A-Bomb|work=Los Angeles Times|author=Long, William R|date=6 October 1990}}</ref>

Rosa died on 3 March 2022, at the age of 80, from COVID-19, during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://oespecialista.com.br/luiz-pinguelli-rosa-morre-de-covid/?fbclid=IwAR1tKM0GtDb_yBnNmR0W3posk7QlBXUMYFOQaMyhbwe6Cwi3dNoxgF-tvH0 | title=Físico Luiz Pinguelli Rosa, ex-presidente da Eletrobras, morre de covid | date=3 March 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Morre o físico Luiz Pinguelli Rosa, ex-diretor da Coppe e ex-presidente da Eletrobrás |url=https://g1.globo.com/rj/rio-de-janeiro/noticia/2022/03/03/morre-o-fisico-luiz-pinguelli-rosa.ghtml |access-date=3 March 2022 |publisher=g1 |date=3 March 2022}}</ref>
